decision.default: inherit normal scheduling policy and nice level
decision.negative_nice: not recommended: nice -n -5 was denied without CAP_SYS_NICE and silently ran the child at nice 0
decision.positive_nice: not recommended for Yoctui: nice 5 increased median p95 wake latency from 0.0781 ms to 0.4696 ms
decision.cpu_weight: not enabled by default: a transient user-service CPUWeight=200 was available but its 0.0871 ms median p95 did not materially improve the 0.0781 ms inherited baseline
